verdicts.note: Not documented as published: IMSLP's '3 Feuillets d'album, Op.23' lists Gigue / Chanson polonaise sans paroles / Reverie-nocturne, but every edition (Litolff 1911, UE c.1910, Augener c.1887) holds the Gigue alone and the 1880 Jurgenson print contains only the Gigue; the page itself says Nos. 2-3 'may never have been edited'. Wikipedia (en/pl) lists only 'Gigue in E minor, Op. 23'. Keep only the Gigue.

Exists: Op. 12 'Deux mazurkas de salon', No. 1 Sielanka (A la champetre), No. 2 Chanson polonaise (Piesn polska) - IMSLP lists No. 1 'Sielanka la Champetre' and No. 2 'Chanson Polonaise'; Polish and English Wikipedia agree. Editions: Kistner (plate 2026), Augener (ed. Hermann), Universal Edition c.1920, Peters, Schott 1911 (No. 1). Existing id 1349 (Op. 12 No. 2) is consistent. IMSLP gives no keys.

verdicts.title: Allegro de sonate in G minor, Op. 2
verdicts.note: Exists: 'Allegro de sonate (Presto) pour violon et piano concertant', Paris 1848, G minor, co-composed with brother Jozef Wieniawski, dedicated to Moniuszko; first edition Leipzig: Kistner 1854 (plate 2061); new edition by Jozef, Kistner 1898. Key added; IMSLP lists it under Collaborations.

verdicts.title: Grand duo polonais in G major, Op. 8
verdicts.note: Exists: 'Grand duo polonais pour violon et piano concertant', G major, co-composed with Jozef Wieniawski (his Op. 5), Berlin: Bote & Bock 1855 (plate 2921); Polish Wikipedia dates it c.1852. Key added; IMSLP lists it under Collaborations.

existing_issues.issue: Title conflates two different Kreisler arrangements. Kreisler's 'Caprice in A minor' is Wieniawski's Etude-Caprice Op. 18 No. 4 (Carl Fischer 1913, plate 18); 'Alla saltarella' is Op. 10 No. 5 in E-flat major (Schott 1913, plate 17), not A minor.
existing_issues.suggested_title: Caprice in A minor, Op. 18 No. 4 (arr. Kreisler)

existing_issues.issue: This is Kreisler's arrangement of L'Ecole moderne Op. 10 No. 5 'Alla saltarella' (E-flat major); the nickname/opus should be in the title.
existing_issues.suggested_title: Caprice in E-flat major "Alla saltarella", Op. 10 No. 5 (arr. Kreisler)

existing_issues.issue: Could not verify: IMSLP lists no Heifetz arrangement of any Wieniawski piece (Heifetz category has only two arrangements; Op. 10 and Op. 18 pages list only Kreisler/Hochstein). Source work and key ('E major') need checking; possibly a mis-attribution of one of the Kreisler caprices.
Accompaniment should be '2 violins' (IMSLP: 8 Etudes for Two Violins, Op. 18), not 'Unaccompanied'.
Gigue is No. 1 of '3 Feuillets d'album, Op. 23'; add the number (key E minor confirmed by en/pl Wikipedia). No. 3 Reverie-nocturne (queued N1) is not documented as published.
existing_issues.suggested_title: Gigue in E minor, Op. 23 No. 1
